[[File:Gametab-research.png|centre|thumb]][[File:Research-panel.png|right|237x237px]]
{{description|Enter the Research Facilities to improve your grinding potential. There you will be able to advance your research progress, unlock and buy special upgrades which will boost all your abilities hugely. Your research points in each branch are limited by the amount of Reincarnations you have.<ref>''RG v1 in the game description seems to have disappeared in v2.''</ref>}}

The '''Research''' progress system was implemented in the Secrets [[Updates#1.6 Secrets Of the Underworld|expansion]] series<ref>''Secret expansion series: [[Updates#1.4 Secrets Of The Realm|Secrets of the Realm]], [[Updates#1.5 Secrets Of The Ancients|Secrets of the Ancients]], [[Updates#1.6 Secrets Of the Underworld|Secrets of the Underworld]].''</ref> bringing "secret" powers to enhance each mythical faction. it is accessible from [[Reincarnation|R16]] for <abbr title="The Original Good & Evil Factions: Fairy, Elven, Angel, Goblin, Undead and Demon">Vanilla</abbr>, R23 for <abbr title="The Ancient Factions: Titan, Druid and Faceless">Neutral</abbr>, R29 for <abbr title="The Underworld: Dwarven and Drow">Prestige</abbr> Factions, R46 for the Dragons, and R75 for [[Mercenaries]].

== The Facilities & Related Factions ==
Research consists of several specialized facilities, each containing upgrades which, once unlocked, will require strategic selecting. Each Facility is related to several Factions: Vanilla factions are related to one facility, Neutral to two, and Prestige to three. Each is unlocked by its related Vanilla Faction (see [[Research#Research Unlock Requirements|unlock requirements]]).

== Research Points & Slots ==
<u>Research Points</u> ('''RPs'''): Facilities are leveled-up with <abbr title="Research Points">RPs</abbr>, which in turn increase the production of the related faction. Each [[reincarnation]], you will receive a defined, and increasing, amount of RPs to meet the increasing costs of the facilities.

<u>Research Slots</u> ('''RSs'''): At specific RPs, the facilities will gain new upgrades. The amount of upgrades you can use is defined by the amount of RSs you have. At certain reincarnation levels, additional RS upgrades can be unlocked. See following table for details.

Upon [[Abdications|abdication]], your gained <abbr title="Research Points">RPs</abbr> will persist, and your <abbr title="Research Slot">RSs</abbr> will get reset, enabling the player to make different [[Research Builds|research builds]] each run.

== Notes & Tips ==
{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:100%;"
!Notes & Tips
|-
|
* E150 and S200 may cause income per second to appear going down when purchasing Royal exchanges.([http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/617116 source])
* 1-135RP [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/562011#posts-9862807 unlock order and tips] by why_amihere
* W320 [http://realm-grinder.wikia.com/wiki/Research_Builds#Titans_R27.2B build]
* Flame of Bondelnar: There are 2 [http://realm-grinder.wikia.com/wiki/Research_Builds#Flame_Chance builds] by artcrow for this
* 590RPs: 200 dwarf or drow Royal Exchanges. A full mana+assistant build seems to be fastest. Druidline outweights Elfline. [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/612789-build-suggestions-for-the-good-590s source]

* S300 can be done faster just by repeatedly casting Brainwave and abdicating, without waiting for the end of the spell.
|}
